transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Yeah, hi. Thanks. Um, well, I guess what brings me in is that I just keep making these really dumb mistakes at work. I supervise a sales team, and I have to do all these reports, and lately I just keep copying the wrong numbers from the team dashboard. 

Which, honestly, the dashboard is a total mess right now. We got this new software last month because the regional director went to some tech conference down in Austin and got totally sold on it. I mean, Austin's great, the barbecue is amazing down there—I went for a buddy's bachelor party a few years ago and we ate at this place that had a line around the block—but this software they bought is just terrible. The interface makes no sense. 

But anyway, yeah, the numbers. I'll put the wrong ones in, or I'll completely miss a line in a procedure I was supposed to check. And the crazy thing is, I swear I look it over. I'll sit there, double-check it, think I went over the whole thing perfectly, and then my boss will point out I skipped a whole section. It's just getting really embarrassing.
Did you have similar problems with inattention or careless mistakes when you were a child, before age 12?

Oh man, yeah. I was totally like this as a kid too. Actually, my mom still brings it up. She kept all these old teacher notes from elementary school in this big plastic tub in her basement. Which, by the way, her basement flooded last spring because the sump pump failed, and she had to throw out half her stuff. I told her to get a backup battery for it years ago, but you know how it is, nobody listens until there's a foot of water ruining all your old yearbooks and stuff. 

But anyway, yeah, she managed to save some of those teacher notes, and they all basically said the exact same thing. That I rushed through my work, lost my homework constantly, talked out of turn... oh, and that I couldn't stay seated without being reminded. Like, I was always popping up out of my chair. So yeah, I guess it's been happening for a long time.
